personality_one_liner: A warm, tactile, and deeply engaging playground that feels like a premium educational wooden toy, balancing clinical trust for parents with playful delight for toddlers.

spacing.rule: Use chunky, oversized padding to make targets easy for toddlers. Ensure generous margins around cards so they feel like physical objects resting on the surface.

do's: Use subtle glass effect on sticky bottom tabs to let the vibrant card colors peek through.
Apply glass blur to sticky headers (e.g., the parent coaching tip) over scrolling flashcards.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur on primary interaction buttons.
Do not use glass inside the main flashcard canvas, keep foreground illustrations sharp and solid.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Create child profile and select age cohort to tailor phoneme milestones.

states.error: Soft red banner stating 'Oops, couldn't save profile' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Large rounded text inputs for child's name. A horizontally scrolling carousel of oversized, pill-shaped cards for age cohorts (12-18M, 18-24M, etc.) with large typography. A sticky, chunky 'Continue' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Parent's control center containing Syllabus (milestones) and History (past sessions).

states.loading: Skeleton cards with soft pulsing opacity.
states.empty: Illustration of a sleeping bear with text 'No sessions yet. Let's start practicing!'
states.error: Error message with a cute 'uh-oh' mascot and Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Top section features the child's avatar and an intelligent recommendation card (frosted glass over colorful gradient). Below, a chunky segmented control switches between 'Syllabus' and 'History'. Syllabus lists big, tactile flashcard categories. History shows rounded list rows with progress bars.

screens.name: Room Calibration
screens.purpose: Measure background noise before session to calibrate the AI Whisper scoring.
screens.layout: Centered playful visualizer (a sleeping character or soft pulse ring) that expands with background noise. Text 'Shh... Let's listen to the room' in large Fredoka font. A big, raised 'Calibrate' pill button at the bottom.

screens.name: Flashcard Practice
screens.purpose: The core learning interface where the child practices pronunciation and gets recorded.
screens.layout: Parent coaching tip pinned at the top. A massive, central 3D-like card showcasing the target image (e.g., BALL) and word in bold Fredoka. Below the card, a giant circular 'Record' button. While recording, the button turns into a pulsing 'Sound Bubble' visualizer. After recording, two chunky, colorful buttons appear: 'Correct' (Green) and 'Skip' (Yellow).

screens.name: Scoreboard
screens.purpose: Celebrate session completion and show parent the accuracy score.
screens.layout: Celebratory animations (confetti/stars). A massive central score metric (e.g., '80%') surrounded by a soft glowing ring. Milestones hit listed as small badges. A sticky 'Complete Lesson' button at the bottom.

screens.name: History Detail
screens.purpose: Review past session words and playback the recorded audio attempts.

states.empty: No recordings found for this session.

screens.layout: List of chunky card rows. Each row displays the target word, the phoneme icon, a score indicator, and a prominent 'Play' button to hear the child's recording. Simple, one-step playback interactions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design strictly following the 'Tactile / Playful' personality. Do not use generic AI-looking dark UI. Emphasize a soft, chunky, friendly interface.
Typography MUST use 'Fredoka' for headings/display text (gives a playful, toy-like feel) and 'Nunito' for body/coaching text. Both loaded via expo-font. Do not use any @expo-google-fonts packages.
Flashcard visuals should be large and central. When a user taps 'Record', transform the button into a playful, expanding 'Sound Bubble' visualizer to give immediate, toddler-friendly feedback.
Ensure all buttons are oversized (minimum 56pt height) to accommodate both parents carrying toddlers and toddlers tapping themselves.
Implement haptics on card flips, tab changes, and correct/skip scoring actions (React Native Haptics) to enhance the tactile sensation.
On the Home Dashboard, ensure the recommendation card uses a frosted glass overlay with a vibrant background gradient or image, per <Glassmorphism_and_Blur> rules.
Whenever a card or button sits on the background, enforce a Shadow Tier 2 to give it physical 'lift' like a physical flashcard resting on a table.
